summary.text: Monty Fritts is a Republican state representative from Kingston representing Tennessee House District 32 (part of Loudon and Roane Counties), a member of the 113th and 114th General Assemblies. He is vice-chair of the Naming & Designating Committee.

paragraphs.text: Fritts holds a B.S. in business and chemistry and an M.A. in theological studies from Liberty University and an M.B.A. from the University of Tennessee; his page lists his occupation as "Retired from Nuclear Manufacturing/Realtor."
He served in the U.S. Army and the Tennessee Army National Guard and is a veteran of the war in Iraq (2004-2005).
In the House he is also vice-chair of the Joint Education, Health and General Welfare committee and sits on the Agriculture & Natural Resources and Government Operations committees.
He is a member of First Baptist Church in Rockwood and a life member of the VFW, the American Legion and the Disabled American Veterans.
